verdict.rationale: Deel's own marketing says it runs accurate, compliant payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers from one platform with 'real-time cost visibility', which loosely touches on previewing totals. Nothing in the pack describes an actual payroll-run flow, so only the general capability is evidenced, not the end-to-end cycle. missing for 10: documented review of hours and earnings within a payroll run, a pre-submission totals preview, a submit/approve step in a single flow, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
